title: Closure of the null-class N_W under colimits in cor:exact-slice uses sequential Milnor lim^1 for general filtered colimits

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location.** Corollary `cor:exact-slice` (the upper-bound half showing $\Sigma^k HM$ is an exact $(kr_G)$-slice), in the verification that the closure class
$$\mathcal N_W=\{X\mid [\Sigma^\ell(G/K_+\otimes X),W]^G=0\ \forall K\subseteq G,\ \ell\ge0\},\qquad W=\Sigma^kHM,$$
is closed under the generation operation (o1), specifically **under filtered/arbitrary homotopy colimits**.

**The claim as written.** The proof argues:
> "Wedges and filtered colimits send $\operatorname{Map}^G(G/K_+\otimes(-),W)$ to products and homotopy limits; for a homotopy limit of spectra each having vanishing $\pi_{\ge0}$ the $\lim^1$-sequence $0\to\lim^1\pi_{\ell+1}\to\pi_\ell\to\lim\pi_\ell\to0$ gives vanishing $\pi_\ell$ for $\ell\ge0$."

**The gap.** The displayed exact sequence is the **Milnor $\lim^1$ sequence**, which is valid for **sequential (tower-indexed) homotopy limits** $\lim_{n}$. It is invoked here for the homotopy limit arising from an *arbitrary filtered* colimit $X=\operatorname*{colim}_\alpha X_\alpha$ in the source, whose image under the contravariant $\operatorname{Map}^G(G/K_+\otimes(-),W)$ is a homotopy limit over the *opposite* (cofiltered) index category. For a general cofiltered diagram there is no two-term Milnor sequence; $\pi_\ell$ of the homotopy limit can receive contributions from higher derived limits $\lim^s\pi_{\ell+s}$ ($s\ge1$), and connectivity (vanishing of $\pi_{\ge0}$) is **not** in general preserved by arbitrary homotopy limits. So the argument as literally written only establishes (o1)-closure for *sequential* colimits, not for the arbitrary homotopy colimits that (o1) demands.

**Why it is genuine.** The generation $\langle\mathcal G\rangle_{\ge}$ that defines $\tau^{\mathcal O}_{\ge kr_G+1}$ is closed under *all* homotopy colimits (o1); to conclude $\tau^{\mathcal O}_{\ge kr_G+1}\subseteq\mathcal N_W$ one must know $\mathcal N_W$ is closed under all those colimits, not just sequential ones. The upper-bound (vanishing) half of the slice characterization — and hence the statement that $\Sigma^kHM$ is an *exact* slice (Cor. `cor:exact-slice`) and the sharpness of the connectivity function — depends on this closure.

**The conclusion is nonetheless true; only the justification is defective.** The clean fix: $\mathcal N_W$ is (an intersection over $K,\ell$ of) the **left/right-orthogonal complement of a set of objects**. Concretely, $X\in\mathcal N_W$ iff for every $K$ and $\ell\ge0$, $\operatorname{Map}^G(\Sigma^\ell(G/K_+\otimes X),W)$ is coconnected ($\pi_{\ge0}=0$), equivalently $\tau_{\ge0}\operatorname{Map}^G(G/K_+\otimes X,W)\simeq 0$. The class of $X$ with $G/K_+\otimes X$ in the **left orthogonal** $^{\perp}(\tau_{\le -1}\text{-shift of }W)$ of a *fixed target* is automatically closed under all colimits of the variable $X$ (mapping *out* of a colimit is a limit in the target, and "left-orthogonal to a fixed object" is colimit-closed in the source by definition of the orthogonality / by adjunction). State it this way (or cite that the $W$-acyclics form a colimit-closed subcategory) instead of via the sequential Milnor sequence.

**To close.** Replace the Milnor-$\lim^1$ sentence with the orthogonality/adjunction argument above (or restrict explicitly to the transfinite-sequential generation and note that $\langle\mathcal G\rangle_{\ge}$ is exhausted by such, with each generator compact — cf. q5-33). One sentence; logically required for the upper-bound half of `cor:exact-slice`.

*Note:* this is distinct from q5-33 (compactness in the *slice-cover* lemma `lem:cover-conn`): that issue concerns mapping *out of compact generators into a colimit*; the present issue concerns the contravariant closure of the *null-class* $\mathcal N_W$ under colimits of the source, in a different lemma.
